    Where Heritage Meets Modern Luxury

    Our Virani Promise

    Each piece reflects the artistry and cultural heritage of Indian craftsmanship, blending timeless beauty with modern elegance. Discover the art of Indian gold jewelry with Virani—where heritage meets innovation, and every design tells a story of elegance and excellence

    Shop with confidence and bring home gold Indian jewelry that becomes part of your legacy

    Frequently asked questions

    What makes Virani Jewelers a trusted Indian jewelry store?

    Virani Jewelers is known for its exquisite Indian gold jewelry collections, offering 22K hallmarked pieces crafted with tradition and precision. As a premier Indian jewelry store, we ensure authenticity, elegance, and exceptional service both online and in-store.

    Why is 22K gold jewelry featured in most of your collections?

    22K gold jewelry reflects Indian heritage with its high purity and vibrant shine. At Virani, we proudly offer handcrafted 22K gold necklaces, bangles, earrings, and more, each celebrating timeless Indian design and fine craftsmanship.

    What payment methods do you accept?

    We accept all major payment methods including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Shop Pay and other popular digital wallets.

    What styles of Indian jewelry can I find at Virani?

    From bridal sets to temple jewelry and modern daily-wear pieces, Virani offers a wide range of Indian gold jewelry. Our collections include antique finishes, meenakari work, filigree details, and gemstone embellishments in classic 22K gold.

    Do you offer certified Indian gold jewelry online?

    Yes. All Virani jewelry is crafted in 22K or 18K gold and comes with purity certification. Our secure online store lets you explore authentic Indian gold jewelry with clear photos, detailed specs, and customer support every step of the way.

    Can I visit Virani Jewelers in person?

    Of course! Virani Jewelers welcomes you to experience our premium Indian jewelry in-store. Whether you’re shopping for a special occasion or daily elegance, our staff ensures personalized service and access to exclusive 22K gold designs.

    Can I pick up my online order in store?

    Store pickup options depend on availability and current policies. Contact customer service or your nearest Virani boutique with your order number to see if in-store collection is possible for your purchase.
